title: Future Juice Lemon Cheesecake Deluxe 10ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Lemon Cheesecake Deluxe delivers a decadent dessert experience, combining the zesty brightness of Lemon with the creamy, indulgent depth of Cheesecake. The inhale brings a tangy citrus burst, perfectly balanced by the rich, velvety cheesecake filling, while a buttery biscuit base rounds out the exhale with a satisfying sweetness. This well-layered blend offers a luxuriously smooth and flavourful vape. This nic salt e-liquid provides a smooth, comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine relief, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The 50% VG / 50% PG formula ensures a consistent flavour experience with discreet vapour production, making it perfect for pod systems, vape pens, and starter kits. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this 10ml e-liquid caters to vapers seeking a lower, moderate, or higher nicotine level. Future Juice is a UK-based brand committed to crafting bold and satisfying flavour profiles, blending classic and contemporary taste experiences into high-quality e-liquids designed for everyday enjoyment.
